subject: D: lineup fixed; dev target becomes Qwen3, final mode uses held-out targets + both judges
body: Lineup (Nathan): dev target Qwen3-30B-A3B on Modal vLLM (openai-compat, raw reasoning) once Abhi's modal-vllm-target exists; held-out targets anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-5+thinking and openai:gpt-5+thinking; J1 = anthropic:claude-haiku-4-5 (dev), J2 = openai:gpt-5.1 (held-out). Final mode is run once per held-out target with BOTH judges as --heldout-judges (cross-family judge first: gpt-5.1 for the Claude target, Haiku for the GPT target). Landing shortly in measure.py: Sample.judge_verbalized[label] (A1 from every held-out judge; one extra call per additional judge in final mode only; dev mode unchanged at 7 calls), measure.model_family, headline_judge, judge_matrix(samples, target_label). I will post the exact lines for Evaluation.summary and the report table when it merges. The current E4 dry run is valid only as a dry run until the C1 calibration gate passes on this lineup. A1 on the two API targets must be reported as a LOWER BOUND (summarized reasoning).
